description: §19.3.3 bare form (S441), RT: load('missing') runs `fail .NotFound(id)` — the bare variant resolves against the declared `! LoadError`, and the call-site `!{}` handler matches `.NotFound(mid)` and lifts @phase = Phase.Missing(mid). Proves the bare form produces the same error envelope (type LoadError, variant NotFound, field-keyed payload) as the qualified `fail LoadError.NotFound(id)`, so handler arm matching and payload binding still work.
rationale: §19.3.3: `fail .Variant` resolves the bare variant against the error type declared in the function's `!` signature (§14.10 applied to the `fail` target); `fail` is `return ErrorType::Variant(args)` (§19.3.2), so the call-site handler receives LoadError.NotFound('missing'). The whole E-ERROR-* family stays silent.
